title: US scalar weapons rumor

tellings.quote: they've told me second hand stuff suggesting that the US has developed what what are called scalar weapons.

plain: The claim is that the United States has built so-called scalar weapons, a name used for supposed weapons that work through unusual energy fields. The journalist Ross Coulthart says people have told him this second hand, and he passes it on to Michels without saying more about what the weapons do. If it were true, it would mean the country holds a secret class of weapon outside known physics.
